en.text: Jesus loved to share truth and light,
Bringing happiness to our life.
On a mountainside, he taught us how to live.
Seeking God’s will first ev’ry day,
With a humble heart, he would pray.
He was kind to all and ready to forgive.
By God’s light, I can see
How to live happily.
By God’s light, I am truly free.
Happy are these eyes because they see!
When anxieties come our way,
We will live our lives day by day,
For Jehovah’s hand provides our daily needs.
As the lilies grow in the field,
How the love God shows is revealed!
If he cares for them, I know he’ll care for me.
By God’s light, I can see
How to live happily.
By God’s light, I am truly free.
Happy are these eyes because they see!
We will build on rock, not on sand.
If a storm should come, we will stand.
Yes, Jehovah’s Word will live in all we do.
Through the narrow gate, we will go.
As he guides our way, blessings flow,
And it leads to life, where all will be made new.
By God’s light, I can see
How to live happily.
By God’s light, I am truly free.
Happy are these eyes because they see!

But to have your love forever Is a real and lasting treasure.
You alone will prove to be Our joy eternally.

His sacrifice has paid the price So joy could be ours for all time.
There is joy in your creation, In the message of salvation,
And the Paradise to come.
But to have your love forever Is a real and lasting treasure.
You alone will prove to be Our joy eternally.
There is joy in your creation, In the message of salvation,
And the Paradise to come.
But to have your love forever Is a real and lasting treasure.
You alone will prove to be Our joy eternally.

cn.text: 你伟大无私，甘愿牺牲儿子生命
为全人类带来拯救，让欢乐幸福到永久！

en.text: Because we are imperfect, O Jehovah,
The inclination of our heart is flawed.
There is a sin that easily ensnares us—
A lack of faith in you, the living God.
Give us more faith, we beg of you, Jehovah.
Please help us out according to our need.
Give us more faith, according to your mercy,
That we may honor you in word and deed.
Apart from faith, no one can fully please you.
We must believe our faith will be repaid.
And as a shield, our faith provides a refuge.
We face the future firm and unafraid.
Give us more faith, we beg of you, Jehovah.
Please help us out according to our need.
Give us more faith, according to your mercy,
That we may honor you in word and deed.
Give us more faith, according to your mercy,
That we may honor you in word and deed.
We love Jehovah with heart, mind, and soul;
But since we are sinful, we need self-control.
Fleshly desires bring trouble and strife;
Living by spirit brings peace and life.
Satan’s temptations confront us each day,
And sin’s law within us can lead us astray.
Power of truth is greater than sin.
Thanks to Jehovah, our minds can win.
Each word and action reflects on God’s name,
So we must endeavor to keep free from blame.
In all we do, we make this our goal:
Always maintaining our self-control.

ko.text: 새 힘과 밝은 희망 주는 집회,

en.text: We live in a world that is wayward and lost;
The way of our God is not known.
We need sure direction to safeguard our steps;
We cannot succeed on our own.
Our meetings refresh us and brighten our hope;
They help us build faith in our God.
They move us with words that incite to fine deeds,
They give us the strength to go on.
We’ll never forsake what Jehovah commands;
His will is what we want to do.
Our meetings instruct us in ways that are right;
Our love for the truth they renew.
Jehovah is keenly aware of our needs;
His counsel by us should be heard.
To buy out the time for occasions to meet
Shows wisdom and trust in his Word.
By wholesome instruction from God-fearing men,
We learn how our faith can be shown.
With loving support from our fam’ly of faith,
We know that we’re never alone.
So as we look forward to much better times,
We’ll meet with the ones whom we love.
And here at these meetings we’ll learn how to live
With wisdom that comes from above.
With wisdom that comes from above.
We thank you, Jehovah, each day and each night,
That you shed upon us your precious light.
We thank you that we have the priv’lege of prayer,
That we can approach you with ev’ry care.
We thank you, Jehovah, for your loving Son,
Who conquered the world; by his faith he won.
We thank you for guidance in doing your will.
You lovingly help us our vows fulfill.
We thank you, our God, for the honor to preach
About your great name and the truth to teach.
We thank you that soon all earth’s woes will be past,
While your Kingdom blessings forever last.

cn.text: 感谢耶和华发出真理之光，
指引你仆人走正确方向。
感谢耶和华让我们有荣幸
能通过祷告天天亲近你。
感谢耶和华无私牺牲爱子，
他忠心至死，战胜这世界。
感谢你教导我们行你旨意，
助我们实践献身的誓言。
感谢耶和华让我们有荣幸
宣扬你圣名和圣经真理。
感谢耶和华即将消除痛苦，
王国会带来永恒的幸福。

나보다 남을 높이 보는 게 어려울지 몰라.

순수한 아이처럼 마음의 벽을 쌓지 않고.

en.text: Jesus kindly showed us That we must be as young ones,
Remembering that in a world of pride, We need a heart just like a child.
We value others, seeing what God sees through his impartial eyes.
Just like a child, we want to love one another,
With our eyes just seeing the good in each other.
Just like a child, we want to be full of kindness,
With our eyes not focused on what could divide us.
And as we’re getting older In a world that’s getting colder,
We easily could question others’ ways, Their motives, and the things they say.
And seeing others as above us is rare this day and age.
Just like a child, we want to love one another,
With our eyes just seeing the good in each other.
Just like a child, we want to be full of kindness,
With our eyes not focused on what could divide us.
Be just like a child.
While we keep growing, Serving Jehovah,
And finding joy in The part we’re playing,
We must remember That in a world of pride,
We need a heart like that of a child.
Just like a child, we want to love one another,
With our eyes just seeing the good in each other.
Just like a child, we want to be full of kindness,
With our eyes not focused on what could divide us.
Be just like a child.

cn.text: 在一个唯我独尊的世界
把眼睛擦亮，尊重所有人就像天父一样
要努力不让怀疑和偏见
渺小的我们，用美好行为荣耀耶和华
我们行走在，漫漫人生路
不停地追寻，快乐与满足
要时刻牢记，在这冷漠世界

en.text: When I called yesterday, I could tell you’d lost your way.
Be assured you are loved By our God up above.
So do not fear. When you’re broken, he is near.
Trust in Jehovah; don’t give in. Just let it go; roll it on him.
You’re not alone; you can pray. He hears your words; he feels your pain.
Don’t keep that burden in. Roll it on him.
Roll it on him. Roll it on him.
Raise your eyes up and see; The new world is in our reach—
No more tears, only love Through the gift of God’s dear Son.
But until then, We can endure down to the end
If we trust in Jehovah; don’t give in. Just let it go; roll it on him.
We’re not alone; we can pray. He hears our words; he feels our pain.
Don’t keep that burden in. Roll it on him.
Roll it on him. Roll it on him.

Roll it on him. Roll it on him.

cn.text: 全心信赖耶和华，别害怕

en.text: Look around us now; See the love on each face—
Out there in the world, hard to find.
All these faithful friends With the love they all show,
Glad to leave that old world behind.
Love never fails; that’s promised. It always will endure.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what Jehovah gives.
That’s what he is.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what we need to live.
And the love here today, In our heart may it stay—
Unfailing love.
Though sometimes it seems Like the cares of this life
Weigh us down and feel hard to bear, Giving brings us joy
When we share faith and hope, Comforted by God’s loving care.
Love will remain; that’s promised. It always will endure.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what Jehovah gives.
That’s what he is.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what we need to live.
And the love here today, In our heart may it stay.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what Jehovah gives.
That’s what he is.
Love—unfailing love— That’s what we need to live.
And the love here today, In our heart may it stay—
Unfailing love, Unfailing love,
Unfailing love.
In the quiet of the night, With a million stars above,
When I think of you and of all you do, It fills my heart with love.

And strength to help me through,

I give my life to you; I give my life to you.

Because you gave me hope That changed my life
And strength to help me through,

I give my life to you; I give my life to you.
Because you gave me hope That changed my life
And strength to help me through,
Because you gave your Son To die for me,
I give my life to you; I give my life to you.

en.text: Take a moment now and picture the scene. Up ahead on the path are what seem to be
Children laughing at play In a world free of the fears we once faced.

“Until the moon is no more”— There is the peace we have been waiting for.

In the new world to come.
Hope is a fire in our hearts.

In the new world to come.

Our God’s outstretched love
In the new world to come.

In the new world to come.

Fulfilling ev’ry living things’ last wish.
Hope is a fire in our hearts. Hope is an anchor that holds us firm.

In the new world to come, In the new world to come.

ko.text: 그 어떤 신도 맞설 수 없으니,

Your mighty works abound
in earth and sky and sea.
No rival god can equal what you have done
​—there is none.
Our foes will be consumed.

His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.
Though ropes of death encircle me, I call to you,
“Jehovah, give me strength,
and give me courage too.”
From your own temple dwelling, you hear my plea,
“Shelter me;
Rescue me, O my God.”
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.

So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.

and give forth your voice.
Your enemies will quake;
your servants will rejoice.

all will see
How you provide escape.
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.

en.text: At times, I felt scared inside, Only looking for a place to hide.
The world made me feel different. Now I hold my head up high.
He said he’d be my confidence, That he’d come to my defense.

Courage to trust him with my life. Jehovah’s always by our side—
Always, always. Jehovah’s always by our side—
Always, always. Jehovah’s always by our side.

即使无依无靠，他也必顾念

Help you win this fight.’

cn.text: 耶和华，只有你懂我的苦
风雨再大你也为我守护
耶和华，只有你懂我的苦

en.text: Jehovah, God of love,
You have promised us your peace.
So we ask you for your spirit;
May its fruitage yet increase.
Our faith in your dear Son,
Who is loyal, ever true,
Gives us access to your friendship;
We are now at peace with you.
Your spirit aids our sight
As your Word gives needed light.
We are guided and protected
In a world as dark as night.
Until the time has come
When all wars and terrors cease,
May your spirit bless our efforts
To maintain our godly peace.
You’ve gathered those you love,
Both in heaven and on earth,
We’re united by your spirit
To proclaim the Kingdom’s birth.
Your righteous Kingdom rule
Soon will bring an end to war.
Then the meek ones will delight to
Live in peace forevermore.

ko.text: 내 상처 깊어 낫지 않고 짐 힘겨우며
나 희망 잃고 좌절하여 약해져 가니,
오, 주의 은혜 베푸시어 새 힘 주소서.
주의 말씀은 약할 때에 위안이 되고
말 못 할 나의 심정 헤아려 주었으니,
주 말씀으로 믿음, 신뢰 키워 주시고
내 마음보다 크신 사랑 알게 하소서.

en.text: Jehovah God, I call to you and ask you:
“Hear my prayer.”
My wounds are deep and slow to heal;
my load is hard to bear.
Despondent thoughts and disappointed hopes
have left me weak.
O God of comfort, care for me;
your favor I do seek.
Do raise me up; help me endure.
When I’m in doubt, make my hope sure.
From deep despair, I turn to you.
Jehovah God, my strength renew.
Your Word has been my comfort and
a refuge when I’m weak,
Expressing feelings dear to me
in words I cannot speak.
Please build in me the faith and trust
that your Word does impart.
And help me always know your love
is greater than my heart.
Do raise me up; help me endure.
When I’m in doubt, make my hope sure.
From deep despair, I turn to you.
Jehovah God, my strength renew.
To whom do you belong?
Which god do you now obey?
Your master’s the one to whom you bow.
He is your god; you serve him now.
You cannot serve two gods;
Devotion cannot be shared.
And so in the end your choice will depend
On how your heart is prepared.
To whom do you belong?
Which god will you now obey?
For one god is false and one is true,
So make your choice; it’s up to you.
Will Caesar of this world
Possess your allegiance still?
Or will you obey the true God today
By always doing his will?
To whom do I belong?
Jehovah I will obey.
My Father in heaven I will serve;
I’ll pay my vows without reserve.
He bought me at great cost;
Devoted to him I’ll stay.
To him I will give each moment I live.
His name I’ll honor each day.

cn.text: 你的抉择显示你的内心
还是决心忠于独一真神，
我愿献出一生为他服务，

en.text: Kind and patient, perfect in love,
Was Christ, who came down from above.
He took care of our needs
With words and by deeds;
He gave of his time and his love.
He would keep the lowly in mind
By healing the sick, deaf, and blind.
To his royal commission he proved true
And willingly said: “I want to.”
We now try to follow his way
In all of our dealings each day.
We are loving and kind
To all whom we find;
We help them to learn and obey.
We respond to friends when in need;
We love them in word and in deed.
So if widows and orphans should ask you,
Then readily say: “I want to.”

ko.text: 내 가족 있는 건 멋진 일이죠.

en.text: Touching down in a foreign land With a thousand miles behind us—
Since we left our home,
It’s Jehovah’s hand That is blessing ev’ry move.
And the work that we do isn’t easy, But it’s all for Jehovah.
And the love that we feel for this fam’ly is real,
So this we say to you:
“We’re all Jehovah’s people; United, we are family.
“And though your land is far away, We love you.
We’re your family.”
Waiting there as our plane came in, You were reaching out to greet us.
Then the music starts, and the day begins, And our love grows even more.
But we know that it’s only Jehovah Who can cause this to happen.
So we’ll praise him together and love him forever
On ev’ry distant shore.
“We’re all Jehovah’s people; United, we are family.
“And though your land is far away, We love you.
We’re your family.”
Silver wings fly across the sea To a land so unfamiliar.
But we bring good news, and the ones we meet Are so gentle, kind, and good.
And the love we receive from our brothers Makes us feel we belong here.
So wherever we are and no matter how far, We love our brotherhood!
It’s good to know That we have family ev’rywhere we go—
From Mali to Mexico, From Japan to Jamaica.
“We’re all Jehovah’s people; United, we are family.
“And though your land is far away, We love you.
“We’re your family.
“From ev’ry tribe and nation— United, we are family.
“These bonds of love are plain to see Because we’re Jehovah’s family!
“Fiji, Tahiti, and New Caledonia— Navajo, Blackfoot, and Cherokee—
“Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, and Estonia— We love you.
We’re your family.”

cn.text: 初来到异地，但我不担心

ko.text: 온 세상 이곳저곳 내가 가는 곳.
날 쳐다보지 않고서는 갈 수 없을 걸.
너도 이 행복을 느끼게 될 거야.

en.text: I’m just a cart made up of bits and pieces— A frame, a handle, and some wheels.
But I’m a cart that helps to give a witness. What is that like?
Let me tell you how it feels.
If you could see what I see, If you could visit all the places that I go,
If you could see the people there
And get a glimpse of all the faces that I get to know,
If you could hear what I hear
When they see things  they’ve never had a chance to see,
That’s when you’ll see how it can be That forever they’ll remember me.
I’ve got wheels; I’ve got racks; I’ve got books, and I’ve got tracts.
I take the Kingdom message ev’rywhere.
When the crowds pass me by, I’m designed to catch their eye.
Wherever people gather,  count on me ’cause I’ll be there.
If you could do what I do,
You’d know the happiness  that always fills my heart.
What a feeling to go wheeling! I’m so glad to be a public-witness cart.

cn.text: 你会看见我有机会认识的每张脸
当人们初次听见真理的喜悦
王国信息随我广为人知
也会好像我喜乐充满心中
作公众见证手拉车真开心

ko.text: 들판 위로 부는 이 시원한 바람.

en.text: Dandelions growing on top of the hill,
Mountains in the distance, wind blowing through the field,
Warmth of the sun casting down from the sky,

He will call; The dead will answer.
They will live at his command.
For he will have a longing
For the work of his own hand.
So have faith, and do not wonder,
For our God can make us stand.
And we will live forever,
As the work of his own hand.

cn.text: 一生匆匆，转眼流逝无踪，
生命脆弱，无奈走到尽头，
是否有一天能够再重逢？
纵然不舍他们已经离去，
他们活在上帝的记忆里，
盼望有一天在美丽乐园，

en.text: Nations align as one,
Opposing Jehovah’s Son.
Their time of human rulership
By God’s decree now is done.
Rulers have had their day;
God’s Kingdom is here to stay.
Soon Christ will crush earthly enemies.
No more will there be delay.
Seek God for your deliverance,
Yes, look to him with confidence.
Seek his righteousness,
Show your faithfulness,
For his sov’reignty, take your stand.
Then see our God deliver you
By his mighty hand.
People on earth now choose,
Responding to this good news.
We offer to all men the choice
To hear or proudly refuse.
Trials, although severe,
Need not fill our hearts with fear.
Jehovah cares for his loyal ones;
Our cries for help he will hear.
Seek God for your deliverance,
Yes, look to him with confidence.
Seek his righteousness,
Show your faithfulness,
For his sov’reignty, take your stand.
Then see our God deliver you
By his mighty hand.

ko.text: 전능하시니, 그 누구도 맞설 수 없네.
그 이름 여호와, 큰 승리 거두셨네.
아무리 강한 적도 큰 수치 겪으리.
그 이름 여호와, 반드시 알게 되리.

en.text: Sing to Jehovah. His great name is highly exalted.
His proud Egyptian foes, He has cast into the sea.
Praise Jah Almighty;
Besides him there can be no other.
Jehovah is his name;
He has gained the victory.
Jehovah God, Most High over all,
The one who is forevermore the same,
You soon will cause your enemies to fall
And sanctify your holy name.
See now all nations Opposing the Sov’reign, Jehovah.
Though mightier than Pharaoh,
They too will suffer shame.
Judgment awaits them;
They cannot escape Armageddon.
Soon ev’ryone will know
That Jehovah is God’s name.
Jehovah God, Most High over all,
The one who is forevermore the same,
You soon will cause your enemies to fall
And sanctify your holy name.

cn.text: 歌颂耶和华，他圣名已经大受显扬。
他将埃及大军全投进大海中央。
赞美耶和华，他伟大全能，力量最强。
独一的耶和华，胜利唯独属于他。
你万世长存，永远不改变。
你即将灭尽邪恶的仇敌，
高傲的列王对抗耶和华正义统治，
尽管势力强大，却必定永远消逝。
哈米吉多顿，审判恶人的日子已近，
人人终将知道耶和华才是上帝。
你万世长存，永远不改变。
你即将灭尽邪恶的仇敌，

ko.text: 그 어떤 신도 맞설 수 없으니,

en.text: The living God, Jehovah, you have proved to be;
Your mighty works abound
in earth and sky and sea.
No rival god can equal what you have done
​—there is none.
Our foes will be consumed.
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.
Though ropes of death encircle me, I call to you,
“Jehovah, give me strength,
and give me courage too.”
From your own temple dwelling, you hear my plea,
“Shelter me;
Rescue me, O my God.”
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.
From heaven you will thunder
and give forth your voice.
Your enemies will quake;
your servants will rejoice.
You prove to be whatever you need to be;
all will see
How you provide escape.
Jehovah provides escape for the loyal.
His servants will see what a mighty Crag is he.
So with courage and faith in our God,
we spread the fame
Of Jehovah, our Source of escape,
and praise his name.

cn.text: 至高上帝耶和华是永活真神，
天地尽都彰显他的智慧大能，
世上再没有别神与他相比，
耶和华必定搭救忠贞子民，
他坚如磐石，仿佛屹立的山岭。
他的忠仆，要鼓起勇气，满怀信心，
全力宣扬、赞美耶和华伟大圣名。
当死亡如绳索紧紧缠绕着我，
求上帝赐力量，使我勇敢刚强，
耶和华我的上帝，请保护我、
耶和华必定搭救忠贞子民，
他坚如磐石，仿佛屹立的山岭。
他的忠仆，要鼓起勇气，满怀信心，
全力宣扬、赞美耶和华伟大圣名。
耶和华发出雷霆万钧的怒气，
仇敌胆战心惊，他忠仆却欢欣。
他将在人前施展拯救大能，
耶和华必定搭救忠贞子民，
他坚如磐石，仿佛屹立的山岭。
他的忠仆，要鼓起勇气，满怀信心，
全力宣扬、赞美耶和华伟大圣名。

en.text: Life everlasting is promised.
Our earthly home will endure.
‘Meek ones will thrive,’ said the psalmist.
This grand future is sure.
We can live forever.
It’s worth all endeavor.
God’s promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
Paradise brought to perfection;
All of God’s children set free.
Under Jehovah’s direction,
Peace on earth we will see.
We can live forever.
It’s worth all endeavor.
God’s promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
Soon in the grand resurrection,
Sorrow will all disappear.
Showering tender affection,
God will dry ev’ry tear.
We can live forever.
It’s worth all endeavor.
God’s promise is faithful.
His Word will come true.
“The signs of the times” prove God’s rule has begun.
In glory enthroned sits Jehovah’s Son.
The heavens are cleansed, Satan’s now debased,
And soon on the earth let God’s will take place.
Rejoice! For God’s tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I’m making all things new.’
These words faithful are and true.
Let all men the pure New Jerusalem see,
The bride of the Lamb shining radiantly.
Adorned for her husband in gems so bright,
And only Jehovah will be her light.
Rejoice! For God’s tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I’m making all things new.’
These words faithful are and true.
This city so grand will become a delight.
Its gates will be open both day and night.
The nations will walk in her glory bright;
The servants of God now reflect that light.
Rejoice! For God’s tent is with men,
And he himself resides with them.
No more will there be pain or worrying,
No sting of death nor any sorrowing.
For God has said: ‘I’m making all things new.’
These words faithful are and true.

cn.text: 末世征象显示王国已建立，
基督在荣耀宝座上登基。
撒但被驱逐，天上已洁净，
上帝旨意将在地上实行。
世上不会再有死亡、痛苦，
人人欢欣快乐，不再哀哭。
上帝说：“现在我更新一切！”
圣城新耶路撒冷万众仰望，
基督新娘发出万丈光芒。
她披金戴玉来迎接新郎，
她的荣光全来自耶和华。
世上不会再有死亡、痛苦，
人人欢欣快乐，不再哀哭。
上帝说：“现在我更新一切！”
伟大的圣城多么令人喜爱，
城门不分昼夜永远敞开。
上帝忠仆反映圣城荣光，
万国将归向这灿烂光芒。
世上不会再有死亡、痛苦，
人人欢欣快乐，不再哀哭。
上帝说：“现在我更新一切！”

ko.text: 이 온 땅이 낙원 될 일,
이 온 땅이 낙원 될 일,
이 온 땅이 낙원 될 일,

en.text: A paradise our God has promised,
By means of Christ’s Millennial Reign,
When he’ll blot out all sin and error,
Removing death and tears and pain.
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God’s will.
Soon here on earth, as God has purposed,
His Son will cause the dead to rise.
Then it will be as Jesus promised:
‘You’ll be with me in Paradise.’
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God’s will.
The Paradise, our Lord has promised,
And he is now our reigning King.
We daily thank our loving Father,
And from our hearts, his praises sing.
A paradise, the earth will be.
With eyes of faith, this we can see.
This promise Christ will soon fulfill,
For he delights to do God’s will.
The God of times and of seasons,
Whose name alone is Jehovah—
The time for his vindication
Is near by signs we can see.
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.
The time has long been appointed;
His Son is ready to conquer,
Defeating all who oppose him.
His sword will bring victory.
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.
Though all creation is groaning,
In faith we’re eagerly waiting.
Jehovah’s day is approaching,
The time for setting us free.
Keep on working and watching and waiting,
Joyfully anticipating,
Life as God meant it to be.

cn.text: 一同不断工作、守望、等候，
一同不断工作、守望、等候，
一同不断工作、守望、等候，

en.text: When the eyes of blind ones see again
And the ears of deaf ones hear again,
When the songs of children fill the air
And joy and peace are ev’rywhere,
When our loved ones will return to life,
To an earth that’s free from sin and strife,
You will see how God these things supplies,
If you keep your eyes on the prize.
When the wolves and lambs will feed as one,
When the bears and calves bask in the sun,
Then a mere young boy will lead them all,
And they will heed his childish call.
When our tears belong to yesterday,
When our fears and pain have passed away,
You will see how God these things supplies,
If you keep your eyes on the prize.

ko.text: 수천 년 어둠 속 갇혀 있는 인류,
이 희망의 닻, 우릴 지켜 주리.
이 희망의 닻, 우릴 지켜 주리.

en.text: Mankind has stumbled for centuries in darkness.
Vain is their quest as they try to catch the wind.
Man’s tragic flaw is revealed in its starkness;
None can they save, for they all have sinned.
Sing with good cheer, for God’s Kingdom is here!
His Son’s mighty reign brings us freedom from fear.
Through him, at last, evil soon will be past;
This hope, like an anchor, is holding us fast.
“God’s day is near!” rings the Kingdom proclamation;
Men will no longer cry out to God: “How long?”
Soon he will free all his groaning creation.
Praise God Almighty, and join our song.
Sing with good cheer, for God’s Kingdom is here!
His Son’s mighty reign brings us freedom from fear.
Through him, at last, evil soon will be past;
This hope, like an anchor, is holding us fast.

cn.text: 自古以来，世人在黑暗中徘徊，
一切努力转眼竟如风消散。
人性弱点已经赤裸裸呈现，
欢欣高歌，迎接上帝王国，
基督的统治带来真正自由。
还有片刻，邪恶不再存留，
抓紧美好的希望，永不放手。
向人宣告上帝的大日子已近，
他将拯救悲伤叹息的子民。
不再听见受苦的人们哭泣，
欢欣高歌，迎接上帝王国，
基督的统治带来真正自由。
还有片刻，邪恶不再存留，
抓紧美好的希望，永不放手。

ko.text: 갓 난 새 생명, 영근 곡식알,
이 고귀한 선물 받게 된 우리,
이 생명의 선물, 이 생명의 기적.
살아 숨 쉬는 이 모든 순간
이 고귀한 선물 받게 된 우리,
이 생명의 선물, 이 생명의 기적.

en.text: Ev’ry newborn child, Ev’ry drop of rain,
Ev’ry golden ray of sun, Each head of grain—
All are gifts from God; They reveal his way.
Miracles performed by him sustain us each day.
So, what are we to do with a gift so rare
But to love the One who gave it and show him we care.
No matter what we do, We never can earn it.
This gift is still a gift​—The miracle of life.
Others may give up, Lose their will to try,
Echoing the wife of Job: “Curse God and die.”
We are not that way; Praise to God we give,
Thanking him for ev’ry precious moment we live.
So, what are we to do with a gift so rare
But to love the ones around us and show them we care.
No matter what we do, We never can earn it.
This gift is still a gift​—The miracle of life.

cn.text: 窗外的雨点、怀里的宝贝，
都是天父的恩典，奇妙珍贵。
朝阳的光辉、澄黄的稻穗，
上帝赐下丰盛恩惠，天天伴随。
多么感激上帝赐宝贵生命，
用行动证明我们真心爱戴上帝。
单凭自己努力，无法赚得生命，
感激天父赐予奇妙生命厚礼。
世人若灰心，思想变消极，
也许像约伯之妻轻看生命。
上帝让我们活得有意义，
要更努力善用一生赞美上帝。
多么感激上帝赐宝贵生命，
用行动证明我们真心爱人如己。
单凭自己努力，无法赚得生命，
感激天父赐予奇妙生命厚礼。

en.text: Can you see with your mind’s eye,
Peoples dwelling together?
Sorrow has passed. Peace at last!
Life without tears or pain.
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you’ll say,
“Life without end, at last!”
In those days all will be young,
All at peace with Jehovah.
Troubles are gone, from now on,
No need to weep or fear.
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you’ll say,
“Life without end, at last!”
Paradise all will enjoy
As we sing of God’s glory.
Long as we live, we will give
Honor and praise to God.
Sing out with joy of heart!
You too can have a part.
Live for the day when you’ll say,
“Life without end, at last!”

songs.title: 139. 우리 함께 새로운 세상에 살게 될 때

en.text: Just see yourself, just see me too;
Just see us all in a world that is new.
Think how you’ll feel, how it will be,
To live in peace, to be truly free.
No evil one will then prevail;
Rule by our God cannot ever fail.
The time will have come for a new earthly start,
The song of our praises
will pour out from our heart:
“We thank you, our God, for all you have done.
All things are new by the rule of your Son.
The fullness of our heart overflows in our song;
All glory and honor and praise to you belong.”
Now see yourself, and see me too;
And look ahead to a world that is new.
No sight we see, no sound we hear
Will cause alarm or give rise to fear.
All has come true, just as he said;
Now over mankind, his tent is spread.
He now will awaken those sleeping in death;
Their voices will join ours with
ev’ry grateful breath:
“We thank you, our God, for all you have done.
All things are new by the rule of your Son.
The fullness of our heart overflows in our song;
All glory and honor and praise to you belong.”

cn.text: 拥抱这焕然一新的天地。
一同来迎接这崭新的世界，
止不住热泪，欢唱满心的喜悦！
耶和华上帝，多么感谢你！
你的爱子已把一切更新。
我们衷心感激，愿高歌称颂你，
一切荣耀赞美永远属于上帝！
绿草如茵，万物重现生机。
上帝呼唤下，死者不再沉睡，
欢欣又雀跃，歌颂上帝的作为！
耶和华上帝，多么感谢你！
你的爱子已把一切更新。
我们衷心感激，愿高歌称颂你，
一切荣耀赞美永远属于上帝！

ko.text: 의의 길에 머무는 그 고운 백발,

en.text: Here with us are aged ones,
Those whose youth has passed.
Here among us they endure;
Still they’re holding fast.
Loss of strength besets them all;
Loss of mates for some.
Father, please confirm their faith
In the life to come.
Father, you remember
How in faith they’ve run.
Give them your assurance;
May they hear, “Well done!”
Splendid is gray-headedness
Found in ways of right.
Beautiful are faithful ones
In Jehovah’s sight.
May we always recognize
They were once young too.
Loyally they gave their best
When their strength was new.
Father, you remember
How in faith they’ve run.
Give them your assurance;
May they hear, “Well done!”

cn.text: 转眼间青春不再，黑发已斑白，
心中无奈又感慨，唤不回挚爱。
虽经历无数悲欢，信念依然在，
天父必顾念关怀，赐美好未来。
天父必不忘记你多么忠心，
他会以你为傲，说：“你做得好！”
忠仆白发是冠冕，美丽又耀眼，
在仁爱天父眼中，你们多珍贵。
奉献出青春岁月，一生不后悔，
为天父尽力而为，忠贞从未变。
天父必不忘记你多么忠心，
他会以你为傲，说：“你做得好！”

ko.text: 충실한 그 이름 모두 다 아네.
확신 잃지 않아 상을 곧 받으리.

en.text: Sarah and Esther, Mary, Ruth, and others—
All these were capable women, loyal wives.
Godly devotion was foremost in their lives.
They were faithful women, ones we know by name.
There were others favored by Jehovah;
Nameless in the record, their faith was just the same.
Goodness and courage, loyal love and kindness—
Lovable qualities in all humankind,
Virtues these excellent women bring to mind.
They were fine examples we appreciate.
In the same way now our Christian sisters
Show a faithful spirit we all can imitate.
Mothers and daughters, sisters, wives, and widows,
Willingly laboring, glad to do your part.
Modest your bearing, submissive is your heart,
Having God’s approval, may you never fear.
Christian sisters, may Jehovah keep you
Firm in your conviction, your prize is drawing near.

cn.text: 以斯帖、撒拉、路得和马利亚
都是古代贤慧忠贞的榜样，
她们乐意遵行上帝的旨意，
表现坚强信心，留下了美名。
许多女子虽然不见经传，
却都忠贞不渝，蒙耶和华眷爱。
和蔼又仁慈、良善、勇敢、忠贞，
都是这些古代女子的美德，
她们的好品行深得人喜爱，
这些优秀妇女都堪作模范。
现代忠心的基督徒姐妹，
也立下好榜样，值得效法、称赞。
无论是身为妻子、母亲、女儿，
你都辛勤工作，努力尽本分。
心甘情愿服从，谦卑又温和，
不用担心，你必得天父认可。
你是耶和华所关爱的人，
他必定帮助你，赐你未来福乐。

en.text: Jehovah is faithful and fully aware
Of all those who serve him whole-souled.
He knows there are times their devotion and zeal
Result in their loss as foretold.
If you have left houses or fam’ly or friends,
Be sure that our God knows the sum.
He makes it up now with our dear brotherhood
And life in the new world to come.
May Jehovah reward what you have done.
May he provide a perfect wage for you.
May you find refuge beneath his wings.
Jehovah is faithful; Jehovah is true.
At times we may feel that our lot in this life
Has burdened us more than our share.
And sometimes it seems that the cares of the day
Are more than we’re able to bear.
The God of all comfort takes note of your need;
You know he’s the Hearer of prayer.
His Word and his spirit and true, loving friends
Will bring to you comfort and care.
May Jehovah reward what you have done.
May he provide a perfect wage for you.
May you find refuge beneath his wings.
Jehovah is faithful; Jehovah is true.

cn.text: 耶和华是忠贞信实的上帝，
如经上所记，人为了好消息，
受家人反对，朋友冷眼以对，
他已赐给你百倍弟兄姐妹，
你决心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘愿付出一切来荣耀他，
上帝可靠、忠贞，必赐你福分。
生活的压力让你喘不过气，
但你不放弃，勇敢坚持到底，
他乐意听你向他倾诉心意，
他赐力量、真理和弟兄情谊，
你决心投靠上帝翅膀下，
甘愿付出一切来荣耀他，
上帝可靠、忠贞，必赐你福分。

en.text: Young man and young woman,
do give your heart to me.
My foe who now taunts me
will then be made to see.
Your youth and devotion
to me you freely give;
You show all the world
that for me you really live.
Beloved son and precious daughter,
Be wise and make my heart rejoice,
That out of your own heart you serve me,
And offer praise by your own choice.
Rejoice and take pleasure
in giving me your all,
And though you may stumble,
I’ll raise you if you fall.
No matter who fails you
or proves to be untrue,
Take comfort in knowing
I’ll always cherish you.
Beloved son and precious daughter,
Be wise and make my heart rejoice,
That out of your own heart you serve me,
And offer praise by your own choice.

cn.text: 你善用青春并将我牢记在心，
使我可以回答那讥嘲的仇敌，
甘心献出自己，每天为我而活，
向全世界证明你有多么爱我。
好好享受你为我付出的时光，
就算失足跌倒，我会在你身旁。
即使有人令你害怕、灰心失望，
我会永远守护着你，绝不遗忘。

en.text: When a man becomes a father
And a woman has a child of her own,
They share a trust, they must remember,
That is not theirs, not theirs alone.
The gift they share is from Jehovah;
Of life and love he is the one true Source.
To parents he gives sure direction
That they may follow the wisest course.
A sacred trust you have been given;
A precious life is in your hands.
You can bestow the greatest favor;
Instruct your child in God’s commands.
All the words God has commanded—
They must always prove to be on your heart.
These words you’ll speak to sons and daughters;
This is your trust, this is your part.
To them you’ll speak along your roadway,
When you rise up and when you are at rest.
In years to come, may they remember,
May they be faithful, may they be blessed.
A sacred trust you have been given;
A precious life is in your hands.
You can bestow the greatest favor;
Instruct your child in God’s commands.

cn.text: 都是父母亲甜蜜的责任。
他赐生命，也赋予人爱心，
将上帝的话语牢记在心，
不分昼夜，都要再三叮咛。

en.text: Precious to God, we are daughters and sons,
Giving our strength as his faithful young ones.
Loving attention to us he will give,
Blessing our days for as long as we live.
Honoring parents who care for our lives
Helps us express what we’re feeling inside.
Then we find favor with God and with men,
Drawing us close to Jehovah, our Friend.
May we remember our God in our youth,
Growing each day in our love of the truth.
Giving our best to our God, we will bring
Joy to the heart of Jehovah, our King.

cn.text: 我们是上帝珍爱的儿女，
善用青春活力，忠贞不渝。
受上帝关爱和悉心照顾，
一生的岁月都蒙他赐福。
感谢父母细心关怀呵护，
愿孝敬他们并衷心顺服。
听从父母必能赢得嘉许，
加深与上帝的珍贵友谊。
趁年轻将上帝牢记在心，
每一天都更加热爱真理。
把一切最好的献给上帝，
让天父耶和华满心欢喜。

ko.text: 내 뼈 같고, 내 살 같은

en.text: This is at last bone of my bone,
Flesh of my flesh; now I’m not alone.
God has provided a partner,
Someone to call my own.
Now we are one; now there can be
Blessings to share for you and for me.
As man and woman together,
We are a family.
Ev’ry day we’ll serve our God above.
As he shows the way,
Unfailing love we’ll display.
As we have vowed, so may it be.
Seasons of joy, may we come to see.
Oh, may we honor Jehovah,
And may you always be my love.
With dignity and joy,
A threefold cord is bound.
With God and men to witness,
These sacred vows resound.
He vowed before Jehovah
To love her from the heart.
“What God has yoked together,
Let no man put apart.”
They both have searched God’s Word
To learn to do his will,
And now they seek his blessing,
Their promise to fulfill.
She vowed before Jehovah
To love him from the heart.
“What God has yoked together,
Let no man put apart.”
Lovingly Jehovah
Made provision through his Son
For our sins to be forgiven
And for death to be undone.
If we truly are repentant,
His forgiveness we can claim
On the basis of Christ’s ransom,
Asking pardon in his name.
We receive such mercy
When we act like God above
And forgive each other freely,
Showing empathy and love.
Putting up with one another,
Putting hurtfulness away;
Showing honor to our brother,
Showing love’s surpassing way.
Mercy is a virtue
That we all should cultivate.
It will keep us from resentment,
From the bitterness of hate.
When we imitate Jehovah,
Who is unsurpassed in love,
We will truly be forgiving;
We will be like God above.
How can we endure
When trials come, as Jesus said?
Through his pain he saw
The joy of better things ahead.
God’s promise, God’s justice,
Were thoughts on which he fed.
We need to have endurance.
Our faith we must defend.
His love is our assurance.
So we will keep enduring to the end.
Though the passing years
May bring us sorrow, bring us pain;
There beyond the tears,
We see the life that we can gain.
To be there, feel free there,
Determined we remain.
We need to have endurance.
Our faith we must defend.
His love is our assurance.
So we will keep enduring to the end.
We will not give up
Nor see the need for doubt or fear.
Faithfully we’ll serve
Until Jehovah’s day is here.
Let’s keep on enduring.
That time is very near.
We need to have endurance.
Our faith we must defend.
His love is our assurance.
So we will keep enduring to the end.

cn.text: 决心满怀希望忍耐到底。
决心满怀希望忍耐到底。
决心满怀希望忍耐到底。

en.text: God’s Word and all it promises
Give reason to endure.
The things you’ve learned and come to love
Are all well-founded and sure.
Be stabilized in holy faith,
Keeping God’s day close in mind.
Stand firm in your integrity;
By tests you will be refined.
Maintain the love you had at first,
Which somehow could be lost.
Despite the trials you will meet,
Endure no matter the cost.
Whatever test may come your way,
Never yield to doubt or fear.
Jehovah will provide escape,
Our God ever will be near.
All those enduring to the end
Are those who will be saved.
The book of life will list their names,
A record clearly engraved.
So let endurance be your aim;
Let it have its work complete.
Jehovah’s favor you will know;
With joy you will be replete.

ko.text: 환히 보게 해 주소서, 내 모습을.

en.text: How can I repay you, what gift can I give
To thank you, Jehovah, for the life that I live?
I look in my heart with your Word as my mirror;
The person I see, may you help me see clearer.
My life I have promised in service to you,
But not from mere duty will I do what I do.
Whole-souled and wholehearted I serve you by choice;
May I be one more who makes you rejoice.
Help me to examine, and help me to see
Just what sort of person you desire me to be.
Those loyal to you, you will loyally treasure;
May I be among those who bring your heart pleasure.

cn.text: 该怎么感谢你，耶和华上帝，
是你赐我生命，愿一生报答你。
你神圣话语帮助我看清内心，
我愿天天细读圣经，省察自己。
我已下定决心一生属于你，
愿全心爱戴你，尽力实践真理。
我已献出自己天天敬奉你，
但愿我一生都使你欢喜。
求你让我知道，我真正为人，
助我察验自己，使我合你心意。
对忠贞的人，你以忠贞待他们，
愿我是你喜爱的人，直到永恒。

en.text: Stay awake, stand firm, grow mighty,
Be determined to endure.
Carry on with manly courage,
For the victory is sure.
We obey Christ Jesus’ clear command;
Under him we firmly take our stand.
Stay awake, stand firm, and grow mighty!
Carry on right to the end!
Stay awake, and keep your senses,
Always ready to obey.
Stay alert to Christ’s direction
Through his faithful slave today.
Heed the counsel of the older men,
Who protect his sheep and truth defend.
Stay awake, stand firm, and grow mighty!
Carry on right to the end!
Stay awake, remain united
As the good news we defend.
Though our enemies will fight it,
We will preach until the end.
Join the shout of praise throughout the land.
Look! Jehovah’s day is soon at hand!
Stay awake, stand firm, and grow mighty!
Carry on right to the end!
Our happy God is merciful,
His mercy not just dutiful.
He takes delight in kindly deeds
And freely grants our daily needs.
Repentant ones can be assured
Their plea for mercy will be heard.
Remembering that we are dust,
He’s merciful and kind and just.
When we have sinned and feel distressed,
When God’s forgiveness we request,
Our Lord, Christ Jesus, showed the way
To ask for mercy when we pray:
“Forgive our debts, we beg of you,
As we forgive our debtors too.”
We then can let resentment go,
And peace of mind and heart we’ll know.
When gifts of mercy we bestow,
The giving spirit we should show.
We give without desiring praise,
Content with joy our gift conveys.
Then God, who sees all things we do,
Will be the One repaying you.
Yes, happy are the merciful,
In God’s eyes they are beautiful.

ko.text: 헌신을 한 백성으로 주의 계명 배우리.
그 교훈 늘 유익하니 항상 순종하리라.
변함없이 충성 다해 형제 곁에 머물리.
여호와의 축복으로 큰 힘 얻게 되리라.

en.text: Ever loyal to Jehovah,
Loyal love we wish to show.
As a people, dedicated,
His commands we want to know.
His advice will never fail us,
And his counsel we obey.
He is loyal; we can trust him.
From his side we’ll never stray.
Ever loyal to our brothers,
Sticking close in times of need.
Ever caring, always trusting,
Ever kind in word and deed.
We show honor to our brothers
And respect them from the heart.
Ever loyal, ever closer,
From their side we’ll never part.
Ever loyal to their guidance
When our brothers lead the way.
When they give us clear direction,
May we loyally obey.
Then the blessing from Jehovah
Will be ours to make us strong.
When we’re loyal, ever faithful,
To Jehovah we’ll belong.

ko.text: 소중한 이 진리 널리 알릴 때,

en.text: As Jehovah’s people sound throughout the earth
Truths about the Kingdom and its priceless worth,
Theocratic order they must all obey
And remain united, loyalty display.
Loyal submission in recognition,
This to our God we owe.
He gives protection, tender affection,
Loyalty to him we show.
God provides his steward and his active force.
These will ever guide us in our Christian course.
So may we be steadfast, seeking God to please,
Loyally proclaiming all his wise decrees!
Loyal submission in recognition,
This to our God we owe.
He gives protection, tender affection,
Loyalty to him we show.

cn.text: 上帝忠贞子民，愿走遍远近，
宣扬王国信息和宝贵真理。
我们乐意顺从上帝的命令，
大家团结一致，对上帝忠心。
决心尽义务，服从耶和华，
上帝必爱护、关怀他忠仆，
上帝赐下力量和忠信管家，
帮助他的子民全心崇拜他。
务要坚定不移，使上帝欢欣，
向人宣扬上帝智慧的话语。
决心尽义务，服从耶和华，
上帝必爱护、关怀他忠仆，

en.text: Nations are troubled as never before.
People are fearful of what lies in store.
Firm and immovable we need to be,
Serving our God faithfully.
Steadfast we all need to be;
Far from this world we keep free,
Standing firm to the end,
Unending life we’ll see.
Snares of the world and temptations abound.
We can resist if our thinking is sound.
Hating what’s bad while we love what is true
Makes us immovable too.
Steadfast we all need to be;
Far from this world we keep free,
Standing firm to the end,
Unending life we’ll see.
Give to God worship that comes from the heart.
In the Lord’s service may we have a part.
Preach the good news, always holding it fast.
Soon the last days will have passed.
Steadfast we all need to be;
Far from this world we keep free,
Standing firm to the end,
Unending life we’ll see.

cn.text: 世界动荡不安、充满难题，
人们难免感到害怕忧虑。
我们必须坚定，忍耐到底，
撒但世界充满诱惑陷阱，
培养健全思想才能抗拒。
我们憎恨恶事、热爱正义，
我们衷心敬拜独一上帝，
全心为他服务不遗余力。
加紧脚步向人传好消息，

en.text: We love Jehovah with heart, mind, and soul;
But since we are sinful, we need self-control.
Fleshly desires bring trouble and strife;
Living by spirit brings peace and life.
Satan’s temptations confront us each day,
And sin’s law within us can lead us astray.
Power of truth is greater than sin.
Thanks to Jehovah, our minds can win.
Each word and action reflects on God’s name,
So we must endeavor to keep free from blame.
In all we do, we make this our goal:
Always maintaining our self-control.

cn.text: 我们都全心全意爱上帝，
虽身心不完美，仍约束自己。
每天要抗拒撒但的诱惑，
而犯罪的倾向导致人犯错。
我们有荣幸代表耶和华，
尽力在言行上立下好榜样。

en.text: The greatest of men was our Lord Jesus Christ;
By pride or ambition, he was not enticed.
God’s purpose gave Jesus the prominent role;
Yet, lowly in heart, he was always whole-souled.
To all who are toiling with troublesome cares,
He offers to carry the burdens they bear.
Refreshment they find as the Kingdom they seek.
With kindness and mildness, he favors the meek.
‘We all are just brothers,’ our Lord Jesus said.
In humble submission, we look to our Head.
The mild and the meek ones to God have great worth;
He promises they will inherit the earth.

cn.text: 我们的主耶稣伟大又崇高，
没有野心，也从不心高气傲，
受上帝任命，肩负重大责任，
却时刻表现谦卑，忠心耿耿。
所有辛苦劳碌、负重担的人，
耶稣愿意为他们分忧解困。
他性情温和，喜爱谦和的人，
通过王国为他们带来福分。
我们要衷心听从耶稣吩咐，
不分彼此，互相关心与爱护。
上帝向谦卑温和的人保证，
他们必在地上乐园享永生。

en.text: On many occasions God spoke to men
By means of his prophets of old.
Today he is saying, ‘Let all repent,’
By God’s own Son we are told.
Do we have strong faith? Is it real?
We must build such faith to survive.
Is our faith proved true by our works?
By means of faith, we’ll be preserved alive.
We gladly obey Christ Jesus’ command
To share Kingdom truth far and wide.
We boldly declare God’s message of hope;
His promise we’ll never hide.
Do we have strong faith? Is it real?
We must build such faith to survive.
Is our faith proved true by our works?
By means of faith, we’ll be preserved alive.
Our faith is an anchor firm and secure;
We never will shrink back in fear.
Our trust in Jehovah helps us endure;
We know salvation is near.
Do we have strong faith? Is it real?
We must build such faith to survive.
Is our faith proved true by our works?
By means of faith, we’ll be preserved alive.

cn.text: 上帝以往通过忠信先知，
今天上帝通过爱子呼吁，
未来必定享受永远生命。
我们乐意听从基督命令，
王国的信息要勇敢宣扬，
未来必定享受永远生命。
即使风暴来袭也不恐惧，
全心依赖上帝绝不放弃，
未来必定享受永远生命。

en.text: Because we are imperfect, O Jehovah,
The inclination of our heart is flawed.
There is a sin that easily ensnares us—
A lack of faith in you, the living God.
Give us more faith, we beg of you, Jehovah.
Please help us out according to our need.
Give us more faith, according to your mercy,
That we may honor you in word and deed.
Apart from faith, no one can fully please you.
We must believe our faith will be repaid.
And as a shield, our faith provides a refuge.
We face the future firm and unafraid.
Give us more faith, we beg of you, Jehovah.
Please help us out according to our need.
Give us more faith, according to your mercy,
That we may honor you in word and deed.

cn.text: 耶和华上帝，我们都不完美，
作恶的念头时常会浮现，
常常犯错，受罪的欲望缠累，
难以对你保持坚强信念。
慈爱天父，请加强我们信心，
求你看顾，使我们更坚定。
所需力量恳求你慷慨赐予，
帮助我们以言行赞美你。
我们信念坚定，深信你存在，
也确信你必定奖赏、恩待。
坚如盾牌，信心能阻挡伤害，
让我们能勇敢面对未来。
慈爱天父，请加强我们信心，
求你看顾，使我们更坚定。
所需力量恳求你慷慨赐予，
帮助我们以言行赞美你。

en.text: O Jehovah, God of goodness,
You have blessed us all our days!
You are holy, ever loyal,
And so good in all your ways.
You show favor, granting mercy,
Far beyond what we deserve.
You’re so worthy of our worship,
And it’s you we gladly serve.
Your own goodness is reflected
In the people whom you choose;
And the proof is in their conduct
And the preaching of good news.
Your good teaching, your good shepherds,
Bear good fruit in many lands.
May you grant us holy spirit,
And may goodness guide our hands.
May you bless our deeds of goodness
To our brothers, great or small.
May we show them special favor
As we work at good t’ward all.
In each fam’ly, congregation,
In each town and neighborhood,
With your blessing and your spirit,
May we be a force for good.

cn.text: 耶和华你多么良善，天天将恩惠赐下。
你的作为至善至美，你既忠贞又圣洁。
尽管我们不配蒙恩，你却以仁慈相待。
能敬奉你多么愉快，你配受赞美崇拜。
你所拣选这一群人反映出你的美德，
他们表现良好品行，也努力传讲真理。
优良教导、优秀牧人带来美好的收成。
求你帮助我们加强乐意行善的愿望。
尽己所能亲切待人，你必定厚赐福分。
我们努力向人行善，对信徒更要关怀。
对待家人或是邻人，都表现良善、真诚。
求你帮助我们决心坚持行善不放弃。

en.text: We praise you, Jehovah, deep from our hearts,
For in your Word we find
Your power supreme, your wisdom so great,
And yet you are loving and kind.
Your Son still invites those bruised by the world
To leave their cares behind.
How kindly his yoke, how tender his heart,
He’s always refreshing and kind.
We see in our God and Jesus our Lord,
The persons we should be.
The power of kindness we can possess.
With kindness, how strong we can be!

cn.text: 感谢耶和华，你赐下话语，
你力量充沛，有无穷智慧，
人辛苦劳碌，渴望得安舒，
他性情温和，他担子轻省，
上帝和耶稣立下好榜样，
仁慈的特质能感动别人，

en.text: Great God, Jehovah, boundless in might,
You have made known your love of right.
Badness prevails on earth below,
Causing us pain, as you well know.
You are not slow, as men may contend;
Your time is near for patience to end.
We look ahead with hope renewed,
Praising your name in deep gratitude.
One thousand years, from your point of view,
Are like a day when they are through.
Time now proceeds to your great day;
It will arrive without delay.
Though all transgression you do resent,
Your heart is glad when sinners repent.
We look ahead with hope renewed,
Praising your name in deep gratitude.
Our Sov’reign Lord Jehovah
Is zealous for his holy name.
He fervently desires
To clear it from unrighteous blame.
Through many generations,
Great endurance he has shown;
In loving, kindly patience,
Not weary has he grown.
His will is that salvation
All sorts of people might attain.
Long-lasting, loving patience
By God will not have been in vain.
The quality of patience
Will help us on our godly path.
It lets our heart be tranquil,
Protects us from unrighteous wrath.
It finds the good in others,
Always hoping for the best.
It helps us keep our balance
In times when we’re distressed.
Along with other virtues
That holy spirit can bestow,
Our patience will assist us
To imitate the God we know.

ko.text: 왕국 평화 온 땅에 넘칠 때까지

en.text: Praise Jehovah, God of peace,
God of unity.
He will make all wars to cease,
Bring in harmony.
Prince of Peace is Christ his Son,
Tender, calm, and kind.
When the fight for right he’s won,
Perfect peace we’ll find.
We have left off angry words,
Making quarrels cease.
We have made from spears and swords,
Implements of peace.
If this peace we want to keep,
Then we must forgive.
Peacefully as Jesus’ sheep,
May we learn and live.
Peace from God gives proof to all;
He has blessed our way.
His commands we gladly keep,
Ready to obey.
We would recommend our way,
Show our peaceful care
Till the Kingdom’s perfect day
Brings peace ev’rywhere.

cn.text: 赞美耶和华上帝，他喜爱和平，
他将使战争平息，大地享安宁。
耶稣是和平领袖，仁爱又贤明，
他必定伸张正义，让天下太平。
我们以和平代替伤人的武器，
决心不口出恶言，不挑起是非。
我们是基督门徒，听从他吩咐，
若彼此甘心宽恕，必享有和睦。
我们受上帝嘉许，能享有和平，
随时都甘心乐意，服从他命令。
我们以言行表明对人的关心，
直到大日子来临，和平遍四境。

en.text: Jehovah, God of love,
You have promised us your peace.
So we ask you for your spirit;
May its fruitage yet increase.
Our faith in your dear Son,
Who is loyal, ever true,
Gives us access to your friendship;
We are now at peace with you.
Your spirit aids our sight
As your Word gives needed light.
We are guided and protected
In a world as dark as night.
Until the time has come
When all wars and terrors cease,
May your spirit bless our efforts
To maintain our godly peace.
You’ve gathered those you love,
Both in heaven and on earth,
We’re united by your spirit
To proclaim the Kingdom’s birth.
Your righteous Kingdom rule
Soon will bring an end to war.
Then the meek ones will delight to
Live in peace forevermore.

cn.text: 仁爱的耶和华，恳求你赐予力量，
我们渴望享有和平，培养出美好品行。
耶稣多么忠心，带领人与你亲近，
我们对他满怀信心，能与你建立友谊。
黑暗的世界里，依靠你保护、指引，
你的话语绽放光芒，为我们照亮前方。
求你赐予力量，助我们维系和平，
满心期盼天下太平，不再有战争、罪行。
天上地上子民，都受你的爱吸引，
合力宣扬王国建立，享和平、团结一心。
王国正义统治，将终结一切战事，
谦和的人鼓舞欢欣，终看见和平来临。

ko.text: 주 깊은 생각, 주 놀라운 일,
주 깊은 생각, 주 놀라운 일,

en.text: Our reasons for joy are abundant,
Like riches increasing in worth.
Those precious to God from all nations
Are joining us in all the earth.
The joy in our heart is well-founded,
With roots reaching deep in God’s Word.
We daily partake of its teachings;
Faith follows the things we have heard.
Our causes for joy are deep-seated,
Like embers that burn in our hearts.
Though troubles and trials beset us,
Endurance Jehovah imparts.
Jehovah our God is our joy,
The work of his hands our delight.
How deep are his thoughts, how great are his works,
Abounding in goodness and might!
We gladly behold his productions,
The heavens, the sea, and the land.
We gaze at the book of creation,
Applauding the work of his hands.
Triumphantly we now bear witness,
Proclaiming the Kingdom of God.
The news of its birth and its blessings,
We joyously spread all abroad.
Eternal rejoicing approaches,
Like daylight that follows the night.
The promised new earth and new heavens
Will bring everlasting delight.
Jehovah our God is our joy,
The work of his hands our delight.
How deep are his thoughts, how great are his works,
Abounding in goodness and might!

cn.text: 他作为奇妙，他意念高深，
他作为奇妙，他意念高深，

en.text: Signs of the times are pointing to the Kingdom.
Good news we tell for all to hear.
Lift up your heads, and look to your salvation;
Time for deliverance is near!
The joy of Jehovah is our stronghold.
Sing loud, and raise a joyful cry.
Rejoice in the hope, and show a grateful heart,
All give praise and laud our God on high.
The joy of Jehovah is our stronghold.
His greatness all must come to know.
With constant devotion to our God and King,
Godly joy in service we will show.
Look to our God, you lovers of Jehovah.
No need to fear, for he is strong.
Stand up and shout with voices loud as thunder;
Sing to our God a joyful song!
The joy of Jehovah is our stronghold.
Sing loud, and raise a joyful cry.
Rejoice in the hope, and show a grateful heart,
All give praise and laud our God on high.
The joy of Jehovah is our stronghold.
His greatness all must come to know.
With constant devotion to our God and King,
Godly joy in service we will show.

cn.text: 末世征象表明王国已建立，
热切期盼耶和华采取行动，
上帝所赐喜乐给我力量，
衷心感激他赐未来的希望，
上帝所赐喜乐给我力量，
一同崇拜伟大君王耶和华，
所有全心爱戴耶和华的人，
一同前来向上帝高声欢唱，
上帝所赐喜乐给我力量，
衷心感激他赐未来的希望，
上帝所赐喜乐给我力量，
一同崇拜伟大君王耶和华，

en.text: When our love is pure and intense,
We make Jehovah’s heart rejoice.
Love is his greatest quality,
Something that we hold dear.
Warm affection glows in our hearts,
Making a loyal friendship grow.
Love always acts unselfishly,
Proving our love sincere.
When we see a friend in need,
We’ll be there to lend a helping hand.
Truly we can be a friend,
Someone who can understand.
Jesus showed what love really means,
Helping us see Jehovah’s love,
Touching our hearts and moving us.
Tender feelings are a start.
Love intensely from the heart.
Loyal love! God is love.
We can sense his care from above.
God by means of his precious Son
Paid the ransom for ev’ryone,
Giving hope that we might possess
Life eternal and happiness.
Hey there, all you thirsty ones,
Come and drink life’s water free.
Yes, come drink, you thirsty ones;
God’s loyal love you’ll see.
Loyal love! God is love.
All his works give proof of his love.
Love Jehovah has further shown,
Giving Jesus the kingly throne.
God’s own purpose has come to pass.
See! His Kingdom is here at last!
Hey there, all you thirsty ones,
Come and drink life’s water free.
Yes, come drink, you thirsty ones;
God’s loyal love you’ll see.
Loyal love! God is love.
May his spirit move us to love.
As we loyally help the meek,
God’s commandments they learn to keep.
We are serving with godly fear,
Preaching boldly for all to hear.
Hey there, all you thirsty ones,
Come and drink life’s water free.
Yes, come drink, you thirsty ones;
God’s loyal love you’ll see.

ko.text: 말할 수 없이 깊고 깊은 사랑!
그 작은 결점 모두 덮어 주며

en.text: The pattern of love, we learn from Jehovah
Shows the way, guides our way.
In all he has done, his dealings have shown us
How to display his loving way.
He gave us his Son, his dearest possession
To cover our sin, forgiving transgression.
What proof of his love​—its greatest expression!
His way is love, Yes, God’s way is love.
When we walk his way, our love for each other
Will be true, warm and true,
Will move us to care for all of our brothers,
Old ones and new, not just a few.
True love for our God and love for our brother,
We can’t have the one and not have the other.
The faults of our friends, we readily cover,
Proving our love, Our brotherly love.
The pattern of love, the bond that unites us
Lets us be family.
Our Father above now warmly invites us:
“Come taste and see real unity.”
Come share in the love and joy that define us;
God’s spirit and Word, he gives to refine us.
Our brothers and friends are here to remind us,
God’s way is love. Jehovah is love.

cn.text: 耶和华上帝，爱的完美典范，
从他的作为我们就能明白，
耶和华的爱流传千秋万代，
他宽恕过犯，甚至牺牲最爱，
献出他儿子把人的罪遮盖，
要效法上帝，表现真挚爱心，
我们要关心所有弟兄姐妹，
我们爱上帝，也爱弟兄团体，
要体现爱心，做得更加彻底，
别人的过犯，我们包容宽待，
用爱心维系弟兄姐妹友谊，
仁爱的天父亲切地邀请人，
请加入我们，共享友爱欢乐，
让上帝力量重新塑造我们。
愿彼此激励，就不轻易忘记：

en.text: We humbly bow to our God in prayer,
That all his qualities we may share.
But most important of all those things
Is love, which having his spirit brings.
We may be talented, wise, or bold,
But we are nothing if love grows cold.
We pray for love that is warm and true,
Revealed in all that we say and do.
Love looks for ways to give graciously
And thinks of others unselfishly.
Love never harbors a hateful thought,
Forgives our brothers, as Jesus taught.
Love helps us patiently suffer wrong,
Bears heavy loads when it’s really strong.
Through ev’ry trial let love prevail;
It bears all things; it will never fail.
God is love, and he invites us:
‘Walk with me and love my way.’
When we love both God and neighbor,
Gracious deeds will fill each day.
Therein lies the key to living;
Therein lies the life we seek.
Christlike love will never fail us;
Christlike love through us will speak.
Love of truth moves us to action;
Love of God moves us to love.
When we fail he seeks to help us;
By his strength we rise above.
Love is pure and never jealous;
Love is kind and bears all things.
May we grow to love our brother;
May we taste what true love brings.
Never let resentment lead you;
May it never take your hand.
Look to God, and he will guide you;
He will teach you these commands:
Love of God and love of neighbor,
Ev’rything that love should be.
May we always show to others
Godlike love, yes, tenderly.

cn.text: 耶和华上帝就是爱，效法他表现真爱。
对上帝和别人的爱，让我们努力行善。
爱心是生活的要诀，爱心是幸福之源。
基督徒将爱心散播，必带来美好结果。
对真理和上帝的爱，让我们彼此相爱。
倚靠上帝克服困难，能继续表现真爱。
真爱既仁慈又纯洁，不嫉妒、包容体贴。
愿我们都培养真爱，得享真挚的友爱。
我们不要怀怒在心，也不要愤恨不平，
寻求天父受他指引，留意他一切提醒。
爱上帝也要爱别人，凡事以爱心相待。
我们要时刻显真爱，愿爱心、温情永在。

en.text: Sov’reign, Jehovah, merciful Father,
Greater you are than our sinful hearts.
Lighten our burden, soften our anguish,
Give us the comfort your spirit imparts.
Father, we all fall short of your glory;
Times there have been when we’ve lost our way.
God, we implore you: Hear our petition.
Give us your spirit to guide us each day.
When we are weary, weak, or discouraged,
Your active force will our hearts renew.
Give us the strength to soar like the eagles;
May we receive holy spirit from you.

cn.text: 耶和华上帝，慈爱的天父，
你为人分担烦恼和痛苦，
赐下力量使我们得安舒。
我们不完美，常常会犯错，
愿天父细听我们的呼求，
赐下力量指引我们生活。
当灰心沮丧或疲倦软弱，
我们仰望你赐所需力量，
让我们如飞鹰展翅翱翔。

en.text: Help in our lives, Jehovah provides,
Shepherds to tend his flock.
By their example they serve as guides,
Showing us how to walk.
God gives us men who have earned our trust,
Men who are loyal and true.
They show concern for his precious sheep;
Love them for all that they do.
Shepherds who love us care how we feel;
Gently they guide the way.
When we are hurt, they help us to heal,
Kind in the words they say.
God gives us men who have earned our trust,
Men who are loyal and true.
They show concern for his precious sheep;
Love them for all that they do.
Godly advice and counsel they give,
That we may never stray.
Thus they assist us, God’s way to live,
Serving him ev’ry day.
God gives us men who have earned our trust,
Men who are loyal and true.
They show concern for his precious sheep;
Love them for all that they do.
Many are the weaknesses
That we all possess.
Still Jehovah cares for us,
Loves us nonetheless.
He is so merciful;
His love, so powerful.
May we show this kind of love,
Help those in distress.
Some at times are weak in faith,
Strong though they appear.
By our reassuring words,
We can calm their fears.
Weak ones to God belong;
His spirit makes them strong.
May we feel their pain and cares,
Help them dry their tears.
Rather than condemn the weak,
We should bear in mind
How much we can strengthen them
By our being kind.
May we be diligent,
Give them encouragement.
As we lend our kind support,
Comfort they will find.

cn.text: 每个人都曾有过软弱的时候，
但耶和华关心我，他深爱着我。
上帝仁慈和蔼，对人充满关爱。
效法上帝显真爱，给彼此温暖。
坚强的也会软弱，灰心又受挫，
良言使他们振作，不再有烦忧。
陪在他们身边，擦去悲伤眼泪。
他们属于耶和华，必得到力量。
要体恤软弱的人，不批评指责。
说话仁慈又体贴，多令人安慰。
我们竭尽全力，互相关怀鼓励，
要彼此分忧解难，以温情相伴。

en.text: From a world divided and cold,
God has brought us into his fold.
Unity and peace we possess,
Bringing us happiness.
Unity we cherish;
Harmony is sweet.
In God’s work there’s much to be done.
He directs us now through his Son.
May we serve obediently,
Working in harmony.
As we pray to be of one mind,
Always tender, loving, and kind,
Love will grow and praise will increase,
Giving us joy and peace.
Peace is so refreshing,
Bringing such delight.
As we show true brotherly love,
God will grant us peace from above.
With his help, united we’ll be,
Serving him endlessly.
Myriads on myriads of brothers,
Millions for all to see,
Each one a faithful witness,
Firm in integrity.
Myriads we are on myriads,
Growing, a mighty crowd,
From ev’ry nation and tribe and tongue,
We praise our God aloud.
Myriads on myriads of brothers,
We preach both far and near
“Good news of something better,”
Which millions long to hear.
And as we keep on preaching,
Though we at times are stressed,
Jesus refreshes the weary souls;
He gives us peace and rest.
Myriads on myriads of brothers,
God keeps us in his sight,
Safe in his earthly courtyards,
Serving him day and night.
Myriads we are on myriads,
With Kingdom news we go,
God’s fellow workers we have become,
Serving him here below.
God’s Word shines like a brilliant light,
Guides our feet through earth’s dark night.
If we follow it faithfully,
Surely its truth will set us free.
He provides us with words inspired,
Helps us learn what is required.
Holy writings can motivate,
Show how to teach and set things straight.
By these words from our God above,
We have come to know his love.
As we read in it ev’ry day,
God’s Word will keep us on the way.
Life depends on Jehovah’s Word,
All the things he has said.
We must live not on bread alone;
Live by his Word instead.
Even now we have peace and joy,
Future blessings assured.
Man must live not on bread alone;
Life depends on God’s Word.
There we find what we daily need;
Life depends on God’s Word.
True accounts in God’s written Word
Tell about those of old.
Men and women who walked in faith—
They were loyal and bold.
We’re encouraged each time we read
All they did and endured.
Man must live not on bread alone;
Life depends on God’s Word.
There we find what we daily need;
Life depends on God’s Word.
Day by day as we read God’s Word,
He gives comfort and hope.
When the trials of life arise,
He gives wisdom to cope.
May we treasure within our heart
All we’ve read and we’ve heard.
Man must live not on bread alone;
Life depends on God’s Word.
There we find what we daily need;
Life depends on God’s Word.

ko.text: 한 장 한 장에 가득 담긴 책.
성경은 상상 못 할 평화 주니

en.text: There is a book that by its many pages,
Brings peace and joy and hope to humankind.
Its wondrous thoughts are charged with such great power;
It brings life to the “dead,” sight to the “blind.”
That precious book is God’s own Holy Bible.
Its words were penned by men whom God inspired,
By men who truly loved their God Jehovah,
And by his holy spirit they were fired.
They wrote a record true of God’s creations,
How by his might this universe appeared.
They also told how man at first was sinless
But how his Paradise then disappeared.
They further told about a certain angel
Who challenged God and spurned his sov’reignty.
That challenge led to sin and man’s great sorrow,
But soon will come Jehovah’s victory.
The time has come with reason for rejoicing:
Jehovah rules by his anointed King.
So now we preach the good news of the Kingdom
And share the hope of blessings it will bring.
Within his book are found these cheerful tidings;
A sacred banquet feast on which to feed.
It offers peace beyond all human thinking;
This Living Treasure beckons all to read.

cn.text: 古代一群人全心爱耶和华，
受上帝启示写下他的话。
上帝力量推动他们的内心，
指引这些忠仆完成圣经。
上帝的话语全是金玉良言，
带给人生命、平安和喜悦。
圣经的真理给人无穷力量，
让世人重得光明和希望。
圣经里记载上帝施展大能，
创天地万物，造浩瀚宇宙。
圣经透露人类本受造完美，
却因反叛失去美好乐园。
有一个天使不守他的本分，
藐视统治权，竟背叛上帝，
挑唆人反叛，令人痛苦受罪。
耶和华快要消灭这仇敌。
今天的我们多么快乐欢欣，
基督已统治，王国已建立。
我们宣扬上帝王国好消息，
与人分享未来美好前景。
若天天研读这本神圣典籍，
就仿佛享用丰盛的宴席。
圣经篇章里充满快乐信息，
带来无穷的幸福与安宁。

ko.text: 천사들 역시 알고 싶어 한 일,
알게 된 그 은혜 참 크네!
그 진리의 빛 점점 더 밝아져

en.text: The prophets of old sought to learn of the Christ,
The hope of all groaning creation.
God’s spirit revealed that Messiah would come,
Providing the means of salvation.
The time has arrived, the Messiah now reigns,
The proof of his presence is clear.
How great is the favor of learning such things;
Into these even angels would peer!
Our path now becomes ever brighter;
We walk in the full light of day.
Behold what our God is revealing;
He guides us each step of the way.
Our Lord has appointed a trustworthy slave,
Through whom He gives food in due season.
The light of the truth has grown brighter with time,
Appealing to heart and to reason.
Our path ever clearer, our steps ever firm,
We walk in the brightness of day.
All thanks to Jehovah, the Source of all truth,
We most gratefully walk in his way.
Our path now becomes ever brighter;
We walk in the full light of day.
Behold what our God is revealing;
He guides us each step of the way.

cn.text: 古代的先知热切盼望看见，
上帝曾预告弥赛亚会出现，
如今弥赛亚已在天上掌权，
我们多荣幸能够明白预言，
忠信的奴隶关爱基督门徒，
真理的光芒更加耀眼明亮，
道路更明确，脚步更加坚定，
感谢耶和华让人了解真理，

en.text: Jehovah, our Father, we want to express
How grateful we are that your Word we possess!
All Scripture is inspired;
its truth has set us free.
Its light gives us knowledge; the truth we can see.
Your Word has the power to reach deep inside.
Our thoughts and intentions, it helps to divide.
Your laws are clear and perfect,
your judgments ever true.
Your principles guide us in all that we do.
Your Word, O Jehovah, has human appeal.
Your prophets were like us; they felt what we feel.
Please help us build a strong faith
that follows what is heard.
We thank you, Jehovah, for your precious Word!

cn.text: 我们衷心感激耶和华上帝，
多么高兴能拥有你的话语。
你启示忠心仆人，写下宝贵圣经，
让人认识真理，享自由安宁。
圣经蕴含力量，像宝剑一样，
能穿透人心，辨明意念、想法。
上帝的律法完美，法令真实正义，
他的明智提醒指引人前行。
耶和华的话语能打动人心，
先知的感人记载激发共鸣。
求你使我们坚定，天天实践真理，
感谢你耶和华，赐宝贵话语。

en.text: Bless us as we meet together,
O Jehovah, we now pray.
We are thankful for our meetings;
May your spirit with us stay.
Help us, Lord, refine our worship;
With your Word, oh, do us fill.
Train our minds and tongues to witness;
Love within our hearts instill.
Loving Father, bless our meetings;
Grant us peace and unity.
May our words and may our actions
Magnify your Sov’reignty.
How great is the honor, Jehovah,
To build you a place for your name!
We offer it now with rejoicing
To add to your glory and fame.
Whatever the things we may give you,
They rightly were yours from the start.
Our labor, our skill, our possessions,
We joyfully give from the heart.
May we present this place to you,
And here may your name be known.
We dedicate this place to you;
Please accept it as your own.
And now may we honor you, Father,
By filling this place with your praise.
May glory ascend with the increase
Of those who are learning your ways.
Committing this place to your worship,
We give it our generous care.
And long may it stand as a witness,
Supporting the message we bear.
May we present this place to you,
And here may your name be known.
We dedicate this place to you;
Please accept it as your own.

ko.text: 우리는 일평생 주 섬겨 모든 일로
우리는 일평생 주 섬겨 모든 일로

en.text: Jehovah, this is the day;
Now from our hearts, we want to pray.
How you have honored us, favored us,
More than words can say!
Upon our labor of love,
We’ve seen your blessing from above.
And now a building stands, by our hands,
As the proof thereof.
Jehovah God, it was a priv’lege
For us to build this place for you.
May we continue in your service throughout our days
And bring you praise in all we do.
What happy faces we see,
And what good friends we’ve come to be!
And how we’ll cherish these memories
For eternity!
We saw your spirit, O Lord,
In how we worked with one accord.
And how we’ve added fame to your name;
What a grand reward!
Jehovah God, it was a priv’lege
For us to build this place for you.
May we continue in your service throughout our days
And bring you praise in all we do.

cn.text: 愿意每天衷心赞颂你，一生一世，
愿意每天衷心赞颂你，一生一世，

en.text: As we encourage one another
To serve Jehovah faithfully,
We find the bonds of love are strengthened;
Fine works bring peace and unity.
The love we find among God’s people
Gives each the courage to endure.
Our congregation is a refuge,
A place where we can feel secure.
A word when spoken at the right time
Is, oh, how comforting to hear!
We hear these words of consolation
From friends so faithful and so dear.
How good it is to work together
With those whose hopes and goals we share!
We seek to strengthen one another
And help each one his burden bear.
As we with eyes of faith are seeing
The nearness of Jehovah’s day,
We need our gathering together
To keep us walking in the way.
United with Jehovah’s people,
We hope to serve eternally.
So we encourage one another
To hold to our integrity.

cn.text: 基督徒之间互相勉励，一同忠贞敬奉上帝，
彼此关心能加深友谊，团结和谐、温情洋溢。
弟兄姐妹表现的真爱，给人勇气不断忍耐。
会众是我们的避风港，置身其中得享平安。
亲切问候与真诚关怀，来自忠贞亲密友伴。
合时的言语多么美好，予人安慰、带走烦恼。
大家怀着共同的信念，并肩工作绽放笑脸！
重担要乐于互相担当，彼此信心更加坚强。
我们有信心就能看清上帝大日子已临近。
我们要经常参加聚会，行走正道永不偏离。
上帝的忠仆团结一心，期盼永远崇拜上帝。
弟兄姐妹都彼此鼓励，必能保持忠贞到底！

en.text: If we have listened to Christ, will we show it?
His teaching shines as it shows us the way.
It makes us happy to hear and to know it,
But we’ll be blessed if we know and obey.
Listen, obey, and be blessed
When you hear God’s will expressed.
If you’d be happy and enter his rest,
Listen, obey, and be blessed.
Our way of life, like a house, gives protection
When it is built on the rock, not on sand.
If we apply Jesus’ loving direction,
We’ll build a life which on bedrock will stand.
Listen, obey, and be blessed
When you hear God’s will expressed.
If you’d be happy and enter his rest,
Listen, obey, and be blessed.
Just as a tree rooted deep by the waters
Gives of its fruit when each season arrives,
If we obey as God’s own sons and daughters,
We’ll all be blessed and enjoy endless lives.
Listen, obey, and be blessed
When you hear God’s will expressed.
If you’d be happy and enter his rest,
Listen, obey, and be blessed.

cn.text: 基督的教诲我们天天谨记，
真理之光引导我们的路，
多么高兴能接受他的教导，
虚心遵行必得上帝赐福。
你期望一生快乐又满足，
我愿实践基督仁爱的劝导，
仿佛房子建在磐石之上，
风吹雨打，根基仍扎实稳固。
愿我们持守这正确方向。
你期望一生快乐又满足，
树木栽种在水边，叶茂根深，
按时结果，生长茁壮丰盛。
我们服从耶和华仁爱天父，
他必赐福，使我们享永生。
你期望一生快乐又满足，

en.text: We’re gathered together, Jehovah our God,
Accepting your warm invitation.
Your Word is a lamp that lights up our pathway,
The source of divine education.
Teach me your ways, and make me understand;
Incline my ear to hear your wise command.
Cause me to walk in ways of truth and right,
And make your law my principal delight.
Unreachably high is your wisdom, O God;
Your judgments we find reassuring.
Your Word is a source of unending wonder;
Your sayings of truth are enduring.
Teach me your ways, and make me understand;
Incline my ear to hear your wise command.
Cause me to walk in ways of truth and right,
And make your law my principal delight.

cn.text: 上帝，我们愿接受你的邀请，
你话语仿佛明灯给人指引，
我会细听你智慧的提醒，
请你教我明白永生真理。
求你助我行走正确路径，
愿我深深喜爱你的法令。
上帝，你智慧多奇妙，多高深，
你话语长存，是不变的真理，
我会细听你智慧的提醒，
请你教我明白永生真理。
求你助我行走正确路径，
愿我深深喜爱你的法令。

ko.text: 새 힘과 밝은 희망 주는 집회,

en.text: We live in a world that is wayward and lost;
The way of our God is not known.
We need sure direction to safeguard our steps;
We cannot succeed on our own.
Our meetings refresh us and brighten our hope;
They help us build faith in our God.
They move us with words that incite to fine deeds,
They give us the strength to go on.
We’ll never forsake what Jehovah commands;
His will is what we want to do.
Our meetings instruct us in ways that are right;
Our love for the truth they renew.
Jehovah is keenly aware of our needs;
His counsel by us should be heard.
To buy out the time for occasions to meet
Shows wisdom and trust in his Word.
By wholesome instruction from God-fearing men,
We learn how our faith can be shown.
With loving support from our fam’ly of faith,
We know that we’re never alone.
So as we look forward to much better times,
We’ll meet with the ones whom we love.
And here at these meetings we’ll learn how to live
With wisdom that comes from above.

cn.text: 世人迷失在这混乱世界中，
我们需要指引才能向前走，
聚会让人把希望铭记在心，
我们受到激励表现好品行，
要一生听从耶和华的话语，
聚会帮助我们能行事正义，
天父清楚知道我们的需要，
我们努力参加基督徒聚会，
敬畏上帝的弟兄提供指引，
享有弟兄姐妹的温暖陪伴，
一起展望美好光明的未来，
我们参加聚会不断受提醒，

ko.text: 빛 안에 걸을 힘 얻게 되리.
찬양의 노래는 새 힘 솟게 하고

en.text: Come with rejoicing, and learn about Jehovah.
“Come drink life’s water,” the spirit has said.
Healthful instruction, God has provided.
All those who hunger for truth will be fed.
Never forsaking our gathering together,
We must be taught; we must learn what is right.
Here with God’s spirit, here with our brothers,
Here we are strengthened to walk in the light.
Lips that sing praise, how encouraging to hear them!
Tongues of the taught ones, how sweet is their sound!
Oh, may we always meet with God’s people!
Oh, may we always among them be found!

cn.text: 来认识耶和华，接受他的教导，
圣经说快来喝生命之水！
上帝已赐下健全的教诲，
渴求真理的人必得智慧。
不要轻易放弃基督徒的聚会，
学习正义、领受上帝教诲。
有上帝力量和弟兄情谊，
我们步伐坚定，走在光里。
颂赞上帝之声多么鼓舞人心，
受他教导的人言词动听。
上帝的仆人要经常聚集，
团结一致敬奉伟大上帝。

en.text: Welcome to all who gather here this day
To hear God’s Word and to learn his way.
Life-giving truth he offers to us all;
With thankfulness of heart, we respond to his call.
Thanks to our God for brothers such as these,
Who welcome us and who seek to please.
May we keep holding men of that sort dear,
And now we welcome others who meet with us here.
God’s invitation reaches all mankind,
That all sincere ones the truth may find.
God by his Son has drawn us to His side.
So welcome one another with hearts opened wide.

cn.text: 欢迎你今天来参加聚会，
上帝教导人永生的真理，
我们满怀感谢在他面前聚集。
感激耶和华赐忠心牧人，
愿我们珍惜弟兄的服务，
学习他们榜样，互相关心帮助。
耶和华邀请所有谦卑人
我们受吸引与天父亲近，
也要敞开心胸，彼此接纳欢迎。

en.text: Jehovah knows just what we need
To bring us joy and to succeed.
So he provides so many ways
In which to serve and spend our days.
Reaching out, giving all,
for our God above.
And where the need is great, there we’ll be,
reaching out in love.
There’s work to do in ev’ry land.
Where there’s a need, we lend a hand.
By reaching out, we show we care.
We want to help and want to share.
Reaching out, giving all,
for our God above.
And where the need is great, there we’ll be,
reaching out in love.
And here at home, in towns nearby,
We plan, we build, new skills we try.
We learn to speak a foreign tongue
And bring good news to ev’ryone.
Reaching out, giving all,
for our God above.
And where the need is great, there we’ll be,
reaching out in love.
From house to house, from door to door,
Jehovah’s word we spread.
From town to town, from farm to farm,
Jehovah’s sheep are fed.
The good news that God’s Kingdom rules,
As Jesus Christ foretold,
Is now declared throughout the earth
By Christians young and old.
From house to house, from door to door,
Salvation we proclaim.
It comes to those who make the choice
To call upon God’s name.
But how can they respect the name
Of One they do not know?
To ev’ry home and ev’ry door,
The sacred name must go.
So let us go from door to door
To spread the Kingdom news.
And whether it’s embraced or not,
We’ll let the people choose.
At least we’ll name Jehovah’s name,
His glorious truth declare.
And as we go from door to door,
We’ll find his sheep are there.

cn.text: 挨家挨户将好消息向所有人宣扬，
走遍城镇，传遍乡村，喂养上帝的羊。
基督门徒不分老幼努力传讲真理，
告诉人人上帝王国已在天上建立。
挨家挨户，竭尽全力，宣告得救信息，
帮助所有谦卑的人呼求上帝圣名。
教导他们认识真神，亲近仁爱上帝。
我们必须每家每户传扬上帝圣名。
挨家挨户，不遗余力，传王国好消息，
让人决定是否愿意接受圣经真理。
全力执行传道使命，宣扬上帝圣名。
尽力散播真理之光，找出上帝的羊。

en.text: Jesus has commanded
That we shine our light,
Like the sun, impartial,
Comforting and bright.
Through the Holy Scriptures,
Thoughts of peace are heard.
May we now reflect his light
As we teach God’s Word.
Let God’s Kingdom message
Speak to ev’ry heart;
Let it shine before us
As we play our part.
Light from Scripture guides us
As we bring good news.
Sharing truth with ev’ryone;
Truth is theirs to choose.
Light from acts of kindness
Brightens up this world,
To our words adds beauty
Like a priceless pearl.
May our light keep shining
As we do what’s right,
Then our works will always be
Pleasing in God’s sight.

cn.text: 耶稣吩咐门徒要发出亮光，
像太阳照万物，温暖又明亮。
上帝话语宣告和平的信息，
我们将真理宣扬，为天父增光。
上帝话语亮光给我们指引，
向人传好消息，尽心又尽力。
让王国的信息照亮每颗心，
愿他们下定决心按真理而行。
我们的好行为照亮这世界，
仿佛无价珍珠，明亮又可贵。
每天行事正义，令上帝开心。
愿不断发出亮光，荣耀耶和华。

en.text: At the start of the day, with the sun yet to rise,
We are making our way
with the sleep in our eyes, and we pray.
We are there with a smile for the people we meet.
Some may stop for a while,
some pass by on the street, but we stay.
It’s the life that we choose;
For Jehovah we live.
And whatever he asks, we will do.
In the work we endure,
Whether sunshine or rain.
It’s a way we can say ev’ry day: “I love you.”
At the end of the day, with the sun sinking low,
Feeling happy and tired,
in our heart there’s a glow, and we pray.
It’s a life that we love, always giving our best.
And Jehovah we thank,
for by him we are blessed ev’ry day.
It’s the life that we choose;
For Jehovah we live.
And whatever he asks, we will do.
In the work we endure,
Whether sunshine or rain.
It’s a way we can say ev’ry day: “I love you.”

cn.text: 当曙光刚出现，揉揉惺忪睡眼，
点点头、微微笑，向人人问声好。
每天我都用行动表明：“我爱你。”
当夕阳染天边，捶捶疲惫双腿，
献出我的全部，感谢上帝赐福。
每天我都用行动表明：“我爱你。”

en.text: Our service to God we cherish;
We value our priv’lege to preach.
We buy out the time and give God our best,
For many we still need to reach.
God’s Word invites us: ‘Come taste and see—
See that Jehovah is good.’
Godly devotion brings greatest gain,
We know we’ve done all we could.
For those in the full-time service,
Rich blessings and treasures abound.
By trusting in God to care for our needs,
In all things contentment is found.
God’s Word invites us: ‘Come taste and see—
See that Jehovah is good.’
Godly devotion brings greatest gain,
We know we’ve done all we could.

cn.text: 愿竭尽全力，善用这一生，
深信耶和华必关怀照顾，

en.text: What a joy to teach Jehovah’s sheep
And to see how they have grown.
We have seen how he has guided them
As they’ve made the truth their own.
Jehovah, may you hear our prayer
And keep them in your watchful care.
In Jesus’ name, for them we plead: May they succeed;
May ev’ry one of them stand firm.
Ev’ry day we said a prayer for them,
As their faith was under test.
We made time to teach and care for them;
They’ve grown strong, and they’ve been blessed.
Jehovah, may you hear our prayer
And keep them in your watchful care.
In Jesus’ name, for them we plead: May they succeed;
May ev’ry one of them stand firm.
May they all maintain their confidence,
Trust in God and in his Son.
Through endurance and obedience,
May their race for life be won.
Jehovah, may you hear our prayer
And keep them in your watchful care.
In Jesus’ name, for them we plead: May they succeed;
May ev’ry one of them stand firm.

cn.text: “帮助他们，在真理中坚定不移。”
“帮助他们，在真理中坚定不移。”
“帮助他们，在真理中坚定不移。”

en.text: For those who teach the Word of God,
There is a joyful share.
The benefits that we receive
Are far beyond compare.
We imitate the Son of God
And how he taught with love.
And as we teach, the ones we’re helping
Draw close to God above.
As teachers of Jehovah’s Word,
We strive to do what’s right,
So all may see sincerity
As we reflect God’s light.
With diligence we search God’s Word,
For it has news to tell.
So we can share our heart’s good treasure
And teach ourselves as well.
Jehovah gives us all we need
To teach his precious Word.
So if we pray to ask for help,
We know that we’ll be heard.
We love what’s in the Word of God;
What’s more, we know it’s true.
And as we love the ones we’re teaching,
They’ll soon be teachers too!

cn.text: 教导人上帝的话语，内心喜乐洋溢。
辛劳付出必得奖赏，福分超乎想象。
效法耶稣教导别人，表现真正爱心。
教人真理，帮助他们与上帝更加亲近。
我们先要以身作则才能教导别人。
努力表现上帝美德，待人真挚诚恳。
认真研读上帝话语，重视圣经真理。
向人分享宝贵的信息，自己也能获益。
我们得到上帝帮助，胜任教导任务。
只要我们恳切祷告，上帝必定协助。
我们喜爱上帝话语，确信这是真理，
用爱教导学生，也帮助他们以爱教人。

en.text: In these days, dark and lawless days,
Shines a light we can see.
Like the dawn of another day
That will soon come to be.
Shining through the darkness,
Ours is a message so bright.
It offers hope and light—
Sparkling like the daylight,
Bringing tomorrow in sight—
So ends the night.
Those who sleep need awakening
As the time ebbs away.
We give hope and encouragement.
For their future we’ll pray.
Shining through the darkness,
Ours is a message so bright.
It offers hope and light—
Sparkling like the daylight,
Bringing tomorrow in sight—
So ends the night.
How does it make you feel
when you preach and teach with zeal,
When you know you’ve done your part
to reach an honest heart?
Knowing you’ve done your best;
then our God will do the rest.
Honest hearts he surely knows—
all those to him disposed.
It makes us glad, and we rejoice
to give our heart and mind and voice.
So may our sacrifice of praise
continue all our days.
How does it make you feel
when the words you speak appeal
To the ones whose heart is right
for everlasting life?
Some people turn away,
others might be led astray.
Still we’re glad to bear his name
